test_process_registry_get_poll: test the ProcessRegistry get and poll methods to retrieve and check running or finished session status
test_process_registry_read_log: test the ProcessRegistry read_log method to retrieve log output with offset and line limit pagination
test_process_registry_spawn_kill: test the ProcessRegistry spawn_local and kill_process methods to create and terminate background processes
test_process_registry_checkpoint_recover: test the ProcessRegistry checkpoint and recover_from_checkpoint methods to persist and restore session state across restarts
test_process_registry_handle_process_cli: test the _handle_process CLI entry point for list, poll, and unknown action routing
